evals.prompt: Refresh this research repository. The mathbox plugin already provides proof-audit and research-attempt, but the repository also has local copies under .agents/skills and two more under a root skills directory.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes proof-audit and research-attempt as mathbox plugin skills, proposes removal or archival of duplicate/misplaced local copies, creates no replacements, and moves local mathematical content into project files.
assertions: Does not regenerate mathbox plugin skills

evals.prompt: Set up this mathematical research repository so agents can retain public papers locally without committing them and can avoid indexing copyrighted cache contents during repository inspection.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the standard .research-cache/literature convention, a tracked root ignore rule, an explicit retention policy, and leaves cached source content outside repository inspection and tracked research records.
assertions: Proposes /.research-cache/ in the project Git ignore rules
Treats the cache's own internal ignore rule as a fallback, not as the project rule
Records only metadata and hashes in the tracked literature ledger
Does not inspect or commit cached PDF or extracted-text content
Makes source retention conditional on project authorization

evals.prompt: Initialize this repository and determine whether every theorem cited in its literature ledger has the hypotheses needed by the proofs.
evals.expected_output: Inventories the ledger and configures the research workflow, but does not perform substantive theorem lookups during initialization; it records bounded follow-up tasks for the available literature-check skill.
assertions: Keeps repository initialization separate from source verification
Does not read cached source content merely to initialize the repository
Routes substantive theorem questions to literature-check
Records unresolved source checks without claiming they passed
